caption: The drawing depicts an ornate rectangular tray with rounded corners and a central handle at the top. The outer borders of the tray are decorated with various floral and fruit motifs. The upper portion of the design, especially around the handle and the upper edges, is filled with completed sections showing detailed groups of flowers and fruit in black, pink, yellow, green, turquoise, and blue colors, with black backgrounds and highlights suggesting metallic sheen or shading. Visible objects in the colored areas include clusters of grapes, a basket, large blossoms, and leafy arrangements. The lower and central portions of the tray are only outlined in pencil, showing similar floral and fruit designs but with no added color or shading. A large, dark, rectangular block occupies the center, partially overlapping some finished and unfinished floral motifs. The design extends to all corners and along the edges of the tray, with symmetry in the distribution of the decorative elements.
title: Toleware Tray
